title: Dihydromyricetin ameliorates osteogenic differentiation of human aortic valve interstitial cells by targeting c-KIT/interleukin-6 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Shaoshao; Fan, Leilei; Wang, Yongjun; Xu, Jianjun; Shen, Qiang; Xie, Jianhua; Zeng, Zhipeng; Zhou, Tingwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物DHM通过c-KIT/IL-6信号通路改善主动脉瓣间质细胞成骨分化，属于心血管疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aims: Calcific aortic valve disease (CAVD) is a chronic cardiovascular disease with high morbidity that lacks effective pharmacotherapeutics. As a natural flavonoid extracted from Ampelopsis grossedentata, dihydromyricetin (DHM) has been shown to be effective in protecting against atherosclerosis; yet, the therapeutic role of DHM in CAVD remains poorly understood. Herein, we aimed to clarify the therapeutic implications of DHM in CAVD and the underlying molecular mechanisms in human valvular interstitial cells (hVICs). Methods and Results: The protein levels of two known osteogenesis-specific genes (alkaline phosphatase, ALP; runt-related transcription factor 2, Runx2) and calcified nodule formation in hVICs were detected by Western blot and Alizarin Red staining, respectively. The results showed that DHM markedly ameliorated osteogenic induction medium (OM)-induced osteogenic differentiation of hVICs, as evidenced by downregulation of ALP and Runx2 expression and decreased calcium deposition. The SwissTargetPrediction database was used to identify the potential AVC-associated direct protein target of DHM. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis revealed that c-KIT, a tyrosine-protein kinase, can act as a credible protein target of DHM, as evidenced by molecular docking. Mechanistically, DHM-mediated inhibition of c-KIT phosphorylation drove interleukin-6 (IL-6) downregulation in CAVD, thereby ameliorating OM-induced osteogenic differentiation of hVICs and aortic valve calcification progression. Conclusion: DHM ameliorates osteogenic differentiation of hVICs by blocking the phosphorylation of c-KIT, thus reducing IL-6 expression in CAVD. DHM could be a viable therapeutic supplement to impede CAVD.
abstract_zh: 目的：钙化性主动脉瓣疾病（CAVD）是一种发病率高且缺乏有效药物治疗的慢性心血管疾病。作为从显齿蛇葡萄（Ampelopsis grossedentata）中提取的天然黄酮类化合物，二氢杨梅素（DHM）已被证明对动脉粥样硬化具有保护作用；然而，DHM在CAVD中的治疗作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们旨在阐明DHM在CAVD中的治疗意义及其在人瓣膜间质细胞（hVICs）中的潜在分子机制。方法与结果：通过Western blot和茜素红染色分别检测hVICs中两种已知成骨特异性基因（碱性磷酸酶，ALP；runt相关转录因子2，Runx2）的蛋白水平及钙化结节形成。结果显示，DHM显著改善成骨诱导培养基（OM）诱导的hVICs成骨分化，表现为ALP和Runx2表达下调及钙沉积减少。利用SwissTargetPrediction数据库鉴定DHM潜在的AVC相关直接蛋白靶点。蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）分析揭示，酪氨酸蛋白激酶c-KIT可作为DHM的可靠蛋白靶点，分子对接结果支持这一发现。机制上，DHM介导的c-KIT磷酸化抑制驱动CAVD中白细胞介素-6（IL-6）下调，从而改善OM诱导的hVICs成骨分化及主动脉瓣钙化进展。结论：DHM通过阻断c-KIT磷酸化，减少CAVD中IL-6表达，从而改善hVICs的成骨分化。DHM可作为阻止CAVD的可行治疗补充剂。
